races.title: racingtv.com/freetrial 'Chasing Excellence' Beginners' Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: EMID'IO PEPE finished ahead of Act Of Authority when they met at Aintree in April, and Dan Skelton's unexposed 5-y-o is taken to confirm that form on chasing debut. EMID'IO PEPE (FR) ACT OF AUTHORITY (FR)

races.title: Stratford Extra Raceday 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: EASTERN FIRE looks the clear pick of the Dan Skelton-trained quartet here and gets a confident vote to make amends for his last-flight fall at Perth (upsides winner) on his recent hurdling bow and add to his earlier bumper success. Stablemate Blackswan d'Oroux could emerge as the one to chase him home ahead of fellow hurdling debutant Oykel Bridge and the returning Wallquatari . EASTERN FIRE (IRE) BLACKSWAN D'OROUX (FR) OYKEL BRIDGE (IRE)

races.title: Jumps Look Better On Racing TV Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: MAJOR FORTUNE was a double winner over fences last season and can build on a promising Perth reappearance third to add to his tally here. Lord Of Cheshire has a long absence to overcome but remains with potential and could still have a say with his yard going well, while Sunshine Diamond should strip sharper for a recent Worcester second and play a part. MAJOR FORTUNE (IRE) LORD OF CHESHIRE (FR) SUNSHINE DIAMOND (IRE)

races.title: Trailertrek Towbars Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: LUNE BRILLANTE showed a good turn of foot when going in at the first time of asking over hurdles at Worcester recently and can follow up over this longer trip to thwart Locker Boum who also made a winning start in this sphere at Chepstow and should ensure Dan Skelton's mare doesn't have things all her own way. Padre Arthur also has the form to play a part if back on song on his return. LUNE BRILLANTE (IRE) LOCKER BOUM (FR) PADRE ARTHUR

races.title: Get A Free Trial Of Racing TV Now Mares' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: None of these can be ruled out but it could be worth siding with Dan Skelton's SERVICE MINIMUM who has returned better than ever over hurdles and now has her first go over fences. She Is For Me Boys rates just the pick of the weights of those with chasing experience and is next on the list. SERVICE MINIMUM (FR) SHE IS FOR ME BOYS BEST WOMEN (IRE)

races.title: Annual Membership For Christmas Novices' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Only 2 of these have chasing experience and the accurate jumping of COUNT ADHEMAR could prove a real asset so he is taken to make light of a 5 lb rise for his ready success at Haydock in the spring. Apollon Forlonge enjoyed a good first season over hurdles and could emerge as the pick of the chasing newcomers. COUNT ADHEMAR (IRE) APOLLON FORLONGE (FR) CAN'T RESIST IT
